findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - running the nightly full suite in a TypeScript starter or an adopted Node/Go repository.
This condition requires pytest result lines even when the configured runner successfully executes tests. review.py:445-454 installs only a pytest results hook; node_workers.cjs only limits workers. New evidence beyond the no-evidence ruling: init.py:182 generates `node scripts/test.mjs`, whose lines 44-49 run the starter's API, hooks and browser suites without pytest. These successful suites therefore receive status 1 and a false no-tests message, preventing a green full-suite status. Preserve the empty-run refusal while obtaining test evidence from the supported runners.
findings.title: Successful non-pytest suites are always reported as empty

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - a pytest suite has fewer tests than its configured CI groups.
The new counter runs after partitioning: SuiteSize registers during session start, after pytest-split registers its trylast hook. Contrary to the comment, [Pluggy inserts later trylast hooks first and executes the list in reverse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytest-dev/pluggy/1.6.0/src/pluggy/_hooks.py), so pytest-split has already emptied `items` when this counter executes. An empty partition records zero and fullrun.py:68-74 rejects it. The xdist sibling path also records zero: pytest_configure at fasttest.py:443-447 removes this plugin from PYTEST_PLUGINS before workers start, and [xdist initializes workers from the command arguments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pytest-dev/pytest-xdist/v3.8.0/src/xdist/remote.py), so they never populate forge_collected. Capture the pre-partition count and ensure it reaches the controller for both execution modes.
findings.title: Empty partitions of nonempty suites still fail

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Functional.
Case: normal use - running the repository's existing test suite.
This intentionally changes an empty test command to return 1, but tests/test_testplace_fullrun.py:293-297 still invokes that exact case and asserts return code 0 and the previous message. Consequently test_3_full_run_is_nightly_and_daily fails deterministically with this patch. Update that existing command-level assertion to protect the newly required refusal and repair message.
findings.title: Gate: update the existing no-command full-run test

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test.
Case: normal use - auditing the proof that empty partitions remain valid.
The command begins with a quoted absolute sys.executable path. repo.py:616-618 recognizes only commands beginning with pytest, python/python3 -m pytest, or its listed environment launchers; this command never qualifies for automatic splitting at repo.py:624-626. Setting FORGE_GROUPS therefore runs the same test in both groups. Assertions at lines 56-59 pass without exercising an empty partition and cannot catch the counter-ordering defect. Use a recognized command or explicit shard arguments and verify that one group actually runs zero tests.
findings.title: Gate: the empty-group proof never creates an empty partition

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round: accepting would break the nightly full run for non-pytest client repos and for empty test groups

why: The nightly full run can pass on a clean default branch without running a test: when forge.toml's test is a change-only command, forge test --full selects nothing and reports success
